stories.title: Enable Selective Public Sharing for Private League Content
stories.goal: share specific pages or moments publicly while keeping my league private overall
stories.benefit: I can showcase interesting content externally without compromising league privacy
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can access content sharing controls for any page or moment in private league
Admin can toggle 'Make Public' option for specific power rankings, matchup recaps, or moments
Public content is accessible via direct URL without requiring authentication
Public content displays 'From Private League' indicator and limited league context
League discovery and navigation remain private even when some content is public
Admin can revoke public access for previously shared content at any time

stories.title: Generate Shareable Public Links for Private Content
stories.goal: create shareable links that allow external viewers to access specific private content
stories.benefit: I can share content on social media or with non-members without making entire league public
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can click 'Generate Public Link' button on any content item in private league
System generates unique, secure URL for shared content
Public link provides access to single content item without exposing other league content
Public link displays read-only view with comments and engagement disabled for non-members
Admin can copy public link to clipboard and share externally
System provides preview of how content will appear to public link visitors

stories.title: Configure Public Content Access Restrictions
stories.goal: control what information is visible in publicly shared content from private league
stories.benefit: I can share content while protecting sensitive information like member identities or private conversations
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can set public sharing policies for private league
Admin can choose to anonymize member names in publicly shared content
Admin can hide comments and reactions from public view of shared content
Admin can configure whether team names and logos are visible in public shares
System respects user privacy settings even when admin shares content publicly
Public shares exclude any content marked as private by individual members

stories.title: Track Public Engagement on Shared Private Content
stories.goal: see analytics on how publicly shared content is performing externally
stories.benefit: I can understand which content resonates beyond my league and optimize sharing strategy
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can access analytics dashboard for all publicly shared content
Dashboard displays view counts, unique visitors, and referral sources for each public link
System tracks geographic distribution and device types of public link visitors
Admin can see conversion rate of public visitors who join league or request access
Dashboard shows comparison of engagement between member views and public views
Admin can export public engagement data for external analysis

stories.title: Expire or Revoke Public Content Links
stories.goal: automatically expire public links after time period or manually revoke access
stories.benefit: I can share content temporarily for events or discussions without permanent public exposure
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can set expiration date when generating public link
System automatically disables public links after expiration date
Admin can manually revoke public access for any shared content at any time
Revoked links display 'Content No Longer Available' message to visitors
System notifies admin when public links are about to expire
Admin can extend expiration or make public links permanent if desired

stories.title: Embed Public Content from Private Leagues
stories.goal: generate embed codes for publicly shared content to use on external websites or social media
stories.benefit: I can showcase league content in blog posts, league websites, or social media platforms
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can generate embed code for any publicly shared content
System provides responsive iframe embed code with customizable dimensions
Embedded content displays correctly on external websites without authentication
Embedded content includes minimal branding and optional link back to source
Admin can customize embed appearance (theme, colors, show/hide elements)
System tracks embeds and displays where content is embedded externally

stories.title: Bulk Manage Public Content Sharing
stories.goal: manage multiple publicly shared content items from central interface
stories.benefit: I can efficiently audit and control all public access points for my private league
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can access 'Public Sharing Manager' dashboard listing all publicly shared content
Dashboard shows content type, sharing date, expiration date, and view count for each item
Admin can filter shared content by type, date range, or engagement level
Admin can bulk revoke public access for multiple items simultaneously
Admin can bulk extend expiration dates for selected public links
Dashboard provides summary of total public exposure and recommendations for privacy optimization

stories.title: Enable Guest Access Preview for Public Content
stories.goal: preview exactly how publicly shared content appears to non-authenticated visitors
stories.benefit: I can verify content presentation and privacy before sharing externally
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can click 'Preview as Guest' button when configuring public sharing
System displays content exactly as non-authenticated public visitors will see it
Preview shows what information is visible vs hidden based on sharing settings
Preview includes visual indicators of privacy boundaries and hidden content
Admin can test public link in incognito mode without generating actual public URL
Preview allows admin to adjust sharing settings before finalizing public link
